stem.text: Which statement describes $\beta^{-}$ decay in terms of a simple quark model?

A.text: A down quark changes to an up quark, and an electron and an electron antineutrino are emitted.

B.text: A down quark changes to an up quark, and a positron and an electron neutrino are emitted.

C.text: An up quark changes to a down quark, and an electron and an electron antineutrino are emitted.

D.text: An up quark changes to a down quark, and a positron and an electron neutrino are emitted.
